planSnapshot.title: Shipboard — task creation and persistence
planSnapshot.description: A hand-authored acceptance plan for the English Shipboard demonstration. These browser checks validate visible user outcomes; no language model generated this plan.
planSnapshot.originalRequirement: A user can add a non-empty task and immediately see it on the board. The same task must survive a page reload. Empty and whitespace-only task names must show a clear validation message without creating a task.

criteria.title: A new task appears on the board
criteria.description: Enter a unique task name, submit it, and check the actual task list.
criteria.requirementRef: A user can add a non-empty task and immediately see it on the board.
criteria.expectedBehavior: The newly added task is visible in the task list, not just in the input field.

steps.description: Enter this run's unique task name
Add the task to the board
Verify the new task is visible in the task list

criteria.title: The same task survives a reload
criteria.description: Continue in the same browser as SHIP-01, reload, and check the same task.
criteria.requirementRef: The same task must survive a page reload.
criteria.expectedBehavior: Reloading the page keeps the task that was just added.

steps.description: Verify the same task is still on the board

criteria.title: Blank task names are rejected
criteria.description: Use an independent browser to check empty and whitespace-only submissions.
criteria.requirementRef: Empty and whitespace-only task names must show a clear validation message without creating a task.
criteria.expectedBehavior: The board remains empty and displays an actionable validation message.

steps.description: Open a fresh Shipboard browser session
